text:
Welcome to Voi Phuc Temple, or Linh Lang Temple, located near the beautiful Thu Le Lake. This remarkable site is one of the four guardian temples of Thang Long and is dedicated to the deity Linh Lang. It holds a significant place in the cultural and spiritual landscape of the area.

You’ll find that the temple is free to enter, making it an excellent spot for visitors of all ages. The temple is open daily from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and on full-moon and the first days of each month, the hours extend from 6:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Please be aware that during festivals, it can get quite crowded, so plan your visit accordingly.

While you enjoy the serene ambiance and admire the architecture, take some time to explore the surrounding area, including the lovely Thu Le Lake. This can be an excellent opportunity for photographs and a peaceful stroll.

In case you have any questions about your visit or need assistance, do not hesitate to ask the staff on site. Enjoy your visit to Voi Phuc Temple!
